title: Counting without losing
hints: c.n++ from many goroutines at once is a data race, and increments get lost. sync/atomic provides operations that the hardware performs indivisibly.
Change the field to n atomic.Int64. Then use c.n.Add(1), c.n.Add(delta) and c.n.Load().
type Counter struct { n atomic.Int64 }; func (c *Counter) Inc() { c.n.Add(1) }; func (c *Counter) Add(d int64) { c.n.Add(d) }; func (c *Counter) Value() int64 { return c.n.Load() }
